title: Aetheris Marketplace
description: The plugin allows you to send a message to your discord server about the sale of an item.
body:
Minecraft-to-Discord Marketplace Plugin

This innovative plugin seamlessly bridges your Minecraft server with your Discord community! It allows players to list items for sale on a Discord marketplace channel without ever leaving the game.

How it works:
Hold the item you want to sell in your main hand.
Use the command /sellitem <price> — put the item out of your hand
The plugin instantly creates a rich, embed-style post in your Discord trading channel.

Key Features:
In-Game Convenience: List items directly from your inventory.
Rich Discord Embeds: Posts show the item's name, image, lore, enchantments, and seller info.
Secure Trading: Provides a clear record of all transactions on Discord.
Boosts Community Engagement: Encourages player interaction and economy on both platforms.

Perfect for faction servers, survival economies, and any community wanting to integrate Minecraft and Discord trading!

commands:
/sellitem <price> — put the item out of your hand
/sellmenu — GUI with your sales, click = delete specific
/removesale — delete all your sales
